# India Avenue

> India Avenue is a fine dining establishment located in Greenwich, CT, offering a sophisticated menu of traditional Indian cuisine. The restaurant serves tandoori dishes, aromatic curries, biryanis, and a variety of vegetarian and seafood options prepared with fresh ingredients.

## Menu
Offers a sophisticated menu of traditional Indian cuisine, including tandoori dishes, aromatic curries, biryanis, and a variety of vegetarian and seafood options, prepared with fresh ingredients.
